Production worker  Tegelen  Introductie Looking for a stable, well-paid job in production where you can get your hands dirty and make a real impact? Join MGG in Tegelen as a Production Worker (Grinder) and become an integral part of our production process. You'll grind, finish and inspect aluminium products to ensure they meet the highest quality standards. It's a physically active role in a 3-shift system, including night shifts. Perfect if you enjoy hands-on work and aren't afraid of a challenge.  Wie zoeken we?  - You live near Tegelen and have your own place and transport sorted - You've got experience working shifts (or at least night shifts) - You speak English, German, or Dutch  Wat bieden wij je? €20.18 gross per hour (including allowances - see below for the breakdown) Full-time, 37.5 hours a week in 3 shifts Travel allowance Stable, long-term work Real chance of a permanent contract down the line Room to build your technical skills How does the salary work? Your base hourly rate is €16.06. You get a 120% bonus on all your hours - whether you're working early, late, or night shifts. So €16.06 x 120% = €19.27. Plus, you get €0.91 per hour in ADV on top of that: €19.27 + €0.91 = €20.18 gross per hour. Functieomschrijving This job is perfect for you if you like hands-on work that keeps you active during your shift. Your workday will consist of: - Grinding and finishing aluminum products - Working with tools and machines - Loading products into machines and robots - Checking product quality
